description: Getting set up: use this after signup_start when the person reads you the 6-digit code from their email. Send the email and the code. Returns an Andru API key for this agent.

agentName.description: Optional: your agent's name. The key is named after it.

email.description: The email the code was sent to.

foundVia.description: Optional: how the person or their agent found Andru: moltbook, a2a_directory, mcp_registry (includes Smithery), npm, search, ai_assistant, person or other. Other text is kept as written.

name: signup_verify
title: Finish sign-up with a code
